verdict.rationale: Adaptive streaming quality and manual resolution or frame-rate control are fair questions for a remote desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents adaptive quality under poor network conditions or user-set resolution or frame rate. The docs cover pricing, management, AI and security features, and community comments about general reliability or sharing quality do not address this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
